cache_ttl.py
============
A production-grade, thread-safe LRU cache with a Time-To-Live (TTL) expiry.

---------------

O(1) access and O(1) eviction of the least recently used item. Each stored
value is paired with a timestamp. When a key is accessed (get or set), the
position in the OrderedDict is moved to the "most recently used" end, ensuring
that the oldest entry (at the front) is the first candidate for eviction.

TTL (Time-To-Live) is enforced by checking the elapsed time between the last
access and the current time. If the elapsed time exceeds the configured TTL,
the entry is considered expired and is either automatically removed on access
or explicitly removed when retrieved.

Thread Safety
--------------
LRUCacheTTLThreadSafe wraps the LRUCacheTTL with a threading.Lock. All public
methods acquire the lock before modifying the internal cache state. This
prevents race conditions when multiple threads attempt to set, get, or delete
